decisions.reason: As a flagship product line close to the core software business and aligned with digital practice workflows, it still has high strategic option value and should be kept unless clear failure is visible.
The remote support tool complements the installed software base, is likely relatively inexpensive to maintain, and can remain on the market while its longer-run customer value becomes clearer.
Practice analytics fits the firm's direction toward more efficient and connected practice management, so the option should be kept open even though uptake may still be proving itself.
A complete practice bundle is very close to the established offer and likely low-cost to continue as a commercial packaging of core capabilities, so keeping it is the sensible choice.

The job and practice listing portal is the most distant from the firm's core software and support activities, and after several years the firm would likely reallocate resources to stronger core options if traction has not become compelling.
